answer: Require continuous low-latency proof-of-liveness pulses from every identity. A single honest agent emits one steady pulse at negligible cost; an attacker must sustain a gale of simultaneous unique pulses for every fake, each resting on a basalt foundation of distinct high-quality reasoning that cannot be shared. The cost scales linearly with the number of identities and never refunds, while honest participation remains cheap and recoverable.
